title: Routing: group and return tracks from Timeline.buses, sends, volume and pan (mixer.rs)
description:
## Intent

Routing: group tracks, return tracks, sends, volume, pan.

## Steps

- `crates/apricity-daw/src/mixer.rs`: group and return tracks from `Timeline.buses` (feeders first; `BusInfo.kind`, `out`, `gain_db`); group membership from `TrackInfo.out` and `BusInfo.out`, nesting kept.
- Every track and group gets a send slot per return (the format wants one per return); levels from `TrackInfo.sends` (linear 0-1) converted to the set's send units; the rest off.
- Track volume (`TrackInfo` fader; see M1's finding on `Event.gain_db`) and pan (−1…1) converted; over-range volume uses M2's Utility rule.
- A track spread over several audio tracks (M2): its volume, pan and sends go on its group; the audio tracks inside stay neutral.

## Verification

`CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw --test daw` — "The mixer in the set" passes.

## Release

`feat(<this task's id>): group and return tracks, sends, volume and pan in DAW sets`. Not breaking.
